definition: Targeted check against dated company disclosures; grouping is economic business scope, not necessarily accounting segments.

CSL.basis: Three dated completed-sale releases; remaining building-envelope activities share one general construction-products business.

AFG.basis: The annuity sale closed in 2021 and the marina sale closed in August 2026; current core business is specialty P&C insurance.

NWSA.basis: FY2026 results report Dow Jones, Book Publishing, Digital Real Estate Services and News Media separately.

BOC.basis: The company describes four majority-owned businesses: broadband, outdoor advertising, surety and asset management.

BUKS.basis: FY2026 investor page gives aerospace products and professional gaming services as two operating divisions.

SNFC.A.basis: Q1 2026 filing identifies three operating businesses: life insurance, funeral/cemetery and mortgage.

BBCP.basis: The filing describes temporary power as a newly entered adjacent service line; concrete pumping and washout remain related construction-site services. This two-group economic mapping is an inference from the filing, not its accounting segment definition.

BRO.basis: 2026 filing reports Retail and Specialty Distribution; 2025 10-K places programs and wholesale brokerage in Specialty Distribution and claims services within Retail.

SLGN.basis: Current company business page describes closures, metal containers and custom containers. Its proposed 2026 transaction is not a completed exit. No reference count is imposed because these may be grouped as one general packaging business.

UFPT.basis: Company history records the Molded Fiber divestiture in 2022 and current focus on medical devices.
